# Pirates
The pirate forces encountered on expeditions are divided into three factions: [bold]Scavengers (T1)[/bold], [bold]Pirates (T2)[/bold], and [bold]Mercenaries (T3)[/bold]. The factions field a wide range of forces and equipment; sometimes you will face entire groups rather than individual fighters.
# Scavengers Low-tier raiders and looters. They use improvised and industrial equipment.
[bold][color=#a4885c]General characteristics:[/color][/bold] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Health:[/color][/bold] 100; monkeys have 80 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 3.8 m/s (melee), 3.0 m/s (ranged) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Resistances:[/color][/bold] [color=red]Blunt[/color] 40% [color=red]Slash[/color] 35% [color=yellow]Piercing[/color] 30% [color=orange]Heat[/color] 50% [color=orange]Caustic[/color] 50% - [bold][color=#a4885c]Features:[/color][/bold] night vision, passive regeneration, and EVA equipment

# Cyborgs and Bosses
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Practical advice:[/color][/bold] eliminate medics and controllers first, then deal with the heavy targets. In prolonged fights, pirate squads become more dangerous through role coverage and synergy.
